players.bio: Alan Enzo David Barrionuevo (born 2 January 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays centre-back for Tigre, on loan from Almirante Brown. Career Barrionuevo started his career with Almirante Brown. He made his professional debut in Primera B Metropolitana on 6 May 2017 when he was selected off the bench in place of Josimar Mosquera during a 1–0 win over Tristán Suárez.

Alfio Ovidio Oviedo Álvarez (born 18 December 1995) is a Paraguayan footballer who plays as a forward for Argentine club Tigre. International career Alfio has been called to the U-20 team but only for friendlies.

Diego Omar Dabove (born 18 January 1973) is an Argentine football manager and former player who played as a goalkeeper. He is the current manager of Tigre. Playing career Born in Banfield, Dabove was a Lanús youth graduate and was a part of the first team squad for one year.

Federico Hernán Álvarez (born 7 August 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Tigre. Career Álvarez's career started in 2012 with Argentine Primera División side Belgrano. He was an unused substitute four times during the 2012–13 season, prior to making his first-team debut on 2 September 2013 in a win against Atlético de Rafaela.

Felipe Tomás Zenobio (born 22 May 2000 in Tigre) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Tigre. Career Zenobio grew up in the Tigre youth sector, with whom he made his debut on 22 October 2020 in the Copa Libertadores match lost 5-0 against Palmeiras.
Germán Leonel Guiffrey (born 31 December 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Chilean club Audax Italiano.

Guillermo Tomás Soto Arredondo (born 19 January 1994) is a Chilean professional footballer who plays as right-back for Universidad Católica in the Chilean Primera División and the Chile national team.

Ignacio Russo Cordero (born 13 December 2000) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Tigre, on loan from Rosario Central. Career Russo started out in Rosario with Gimnasia y Esgrima, before later heading to ADIUR. 2016 saw the forward join Rosario Central.
Jabes Saralegui (born 1st January 2003) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Boca Juniors.

Jalil Juan José Elías (Arabic: خليل إلياس; born 25 April 1996) is a professional footballer who currently plays as defensive midfielder for Malaysia Super League club Johor Darul Ta'zim. Born in Argentina, he plays for the Syria national team.
Jerónimo Dómina (born 17 October 2005) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Spanish club Cádiz.
Joaquín Marcelo Laso (born 4 July 1990) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Tigre. Career Laso had youth spells with Ferroviarios, Racing Club, Cadetes and Quilmes.
Mauro Andrés Méndez Acosta (born 17 January 1999) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a forward for Argentine Primera División club Estudiantes de La Plata

Ramón Ginés Arias Quinteros (born 27 July 1992), nicknamed Cachila, is a Uruguayan footballer who plays as a defender for Qatari club Muaither. Club career On 12 August 2022, Arias signed with Giresunspor in Turkey.

Santiago López Grobin (born 9 February 2006) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a winger for Rosario Central, on loan from Independiente. Club career Born in Nono, Córdoba, Santiago López started his career with Club Atlético Independiente at the age of eleven. On 10 February 2022 he signed his first professional contract with the club.

Simón Gonzalo Rivero (born 16 April 2003 in Malagueño, Córdoba Province) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder. He plays as an attacking midfielder and his first team was Boca Juniors of the Professional League. He currently plays for Tigre in the Professional League.

Víctor Cabrera (born 7 February 1993) is an Argentine football defender who plays for Tigre in the Primera Nacional. On 8 January 2015 it was announced that he had signed with MLS club Montreal Impact on a season long loan.
